working: Per NCERT, the descending limb is permeable to water but almost impermeable to electrolytes, so (a) is correct. Water leaves the descending limb, so the filtrate becomes concentrated as it moves down; the key treats (b) as correct. The ascending limb transports electrolytes actively or passively, so (d) is correct. NCERT says reabsorption in Henle's loop is minimal, which is why (c) is likely meant to be excluded. Only option 4 contains (a), (b) and (d).
